greeting: Skywarden Stratos on comms. Stage 1: Beyond the Clouds. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Sky Sanctuary. Objective drift gets teams buried.
If your shadow starts giving tactical advice, charge it rent and keep walking.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Ascend to Aetherreach.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Ascend to Aetherreach; Meet the Aetherguard; Learn of the celestial threats. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Ascend to Aetherreach and discover the floating sanctuaries. Immediate move: Ascend to Aetherreach.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 1 resolved: Beyond the Clouds. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Stellar Observers.
rumor: Someone is tuning the old observatory bells to match heartbeat rhythms.
People keep repeating one clue from Beyond the Clouds: 'Learn of the celestial threats'.
The walls keep whispering patch notes. I only trust the ones with timestamps.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn in Aetherreach is clear-sky math: low noise, high visibility, best scouting window.
dialog.time_noon: Noon stacks wind traffic and patrol traffic together. Plan your crossings.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk paints false horizons here. Verify every ledge before committing.
dialog.time_night: Night turns cloud light into mirages. Keep formation and call targets out loud.

party_reactions.kade: Skywarden Stratos sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Skywarden Stratos accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Skywarden Stratos talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
